scope: Original local employee configuration opened from the IM bottom menu; normal saves, before/after-admission lost answers, explicit read/load, backend round-trip, actual Codex and restart.
limits: The original save uses expectedConfigVersion and conservative reconciliation, not a newly introduced stable request receipt.
The API return leg uses the original Contacts editor; no API inference occurs.
The active-rebind test covers a pending command approval, SIGKILL of the runtime service and two restarts; it does not claim all active work or failure combinations.
Claude/core/ACP save faults, concurrent editors, pending unknown save across restart and all platforms remain outside this increment.
The first offline batch failed at test locator scopes and initial chat selection after restart; its raw outcomes remain preserved.
The complete spec13 scope and prior core cost/timeout reliability remain unfinished.
